$comment: State-surface registry (hirobius/ralph#37, spec hirobius/ops#576). Every file or section that describes project state, and what keeps it true: generated (a generator builds it; `check` proves it fresh), checked (a named gate compares it with the code), editorial (hand-written; owner, reviewedAt and maxAgeDays; scripts/check-state-surfaces.sh warns "review due" past maxAgeDays). After re-reading an editorial file, bump its reviewedAt, then run scripts/generate-agents-md.sh: the front door in AGENTS.md prints it. ignoreReferences lists path prefixes that docs name but this repo lacks (the per-repo files a consumer authors, other repos).

surfaces.describes: What the kit and reusable workflows do, how a repo adopts Ralph, how v1 is released
The test list, one line per suite
The agent front door: what Ralph is, read order, where live state is, index of these documents
Live loop health: queue order, in-flight PRs and wedge state, active claims, recent runs. Nothing is committed; it reads GitHub when run
The kit's decision-table tests (gh and git stubbed); the same run gates the generated docs and this registry
The hand-written intro of AGENTS.md: what Ralph is, read order, working rules, where live state is. The generator includes it verbatim
The per-iteration prompt consumers vendor: the rules a model iteration follows
The run, gate and triage reusable workflows; each header comment is that engine's contract
